paper.title_en: The additive ambiguity of gravitational entropy fixed by the topology of the horizon
paper.abstract_en: In quantum gravity the algebra of observables of a subregion is of type III$_1$ at leading order in the semiclassical expansion, and it becomes of type II once the gravitational constraint is imposed. Hence generalized entropy acquires a trace, however it is defined only up to an additive constant. In this work we argue that in four-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity this constant is the Gauss--Bonnet contribution to the Wald entropy, and that it is carried by the normalization of the trace and not by the state. In particular, the conical expansion of the Gauss--Bonnet density is exactly linear in the deficit angle, and on smooth squashed cones it reduces to the intrinsic curvature of the cut, so that the term is a constant on every smooth cross-section and carries no boost energy. Its Noether charge is invariant under all deformations within a topological sector and central in any algebra that preserves the sector, and thus a state-independent constant on such an algebra can only rescale the trace. Additionally, when the boundary of the subregion is completed as the Euler action requires, the Gauss--Bonnet term does not contribute to the presymplectic form, the crossed product is inherited from Einstein gravity, and the constant is the Euler number of the excised Euclidean tip. We state the hypotheses, we weaken factoriality to a central decomposition, and we illustrate the mechanism in Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity and in topological black holes in anti-de Sitter space, where the topological weight displaces the Hawking--Page temperature and a black-hole merger shifts the coarse-grained boundary entropy by a state-independent amount.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文讨论引力熵的可加性歧义、Wald熵的高斯-博内贡献以及视界拓扑如何固定该常数，涉及广义熵、模代数与修正引力，理论层次深，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 由视界拓扑固定的引力熵可加性歧义
decision.abstract_zh: 在量子引力中，半经典展开领头阶下子区域的可观测量代数属于III$_1$型，而在施加引力约束后变为II型。因此广义熵获得迹，但无论如何定义，它只能确定到一个可加常数。本文论证，在四维爱因斯坦-高斯-博内引力中，该常数是Wald熵的高斯-博内贡献，并且它由迹的归一化承载，而非由态承载。特别地，高斯-博内密度的锥形展开在亏损角上严格线性，而在光滑压扁锥上它约化为切口的內禀曲率，从而该项在每个光滑截面上为常数，且不携带助推能量。其Noether荷在某一拓扑扇区内的所有形变下不变，并且在任何保持该扇区的代数中都是中心的，因此在此类代数上态无关的常数只能重新标度迹。此外，当子区域边界按Euler作用所要求的方式补全时，高斯-博内项不贡献预辛形式，交叉乘积继承自爱因斯坦引力，该常数即被挖去的欧几里得尖端的Euler数。我们陈述假设，将因子性弱化为中心分解，并在Jackiw--Teitelboim引力以及反德西特空间中的拓扑黑洞中说明该机制，其中拓扑权重移动了Hawking--Page温度，而黑洞并合使粗粒化边界熵移动一个态无关的量。
